title: Passkey-themed social engineering leads to identity and cloud compromise
note: Primary research on active cloud intrusions using passkey/SSO lures, AiTM and device-code flows, attacker-added authentication methods, Graph reconnaissance and cloud data collection.

title: Signing in without actually signing in
note: Okta analyzes infostealer data containing reusable session tokens and API keys, a strong reminder that authenticated state can be stolen and replayed without a fresh sign-in.

title: New Okta innovations close governance blind spots and extend zero standing privilege
note: Vendor announcement worth tracking because it explicitly brings governance, privileged access and Permiso-backed identity threat detection into one identity-security platform story.

title: Dropbox breach seemingly caused by egregious authentication failure
note: Independent reporting on a third-party identity-provider integration failure that reportedly exposed thousands of accounts, useful as an authentication and trust-boundary case study.

title: Detect and disrupt AI-themed attacks with Microsoft Defender
note: A concrete device-code-phishing and BEC case study showing how correlated identity, email and endpoint telemetry can disrupt post-authentication abuse.

title: Update on Security at METR
note: Primary incident disclosure covering a fail-open authentication bug, API-key theft, SSH persistence and separate OAuth/credential-stuffing activity.

title: Credential brokering vs. runtime authorization
note: A useful vendor framing of the difference between hiding or brokering credentials and evaluating individual privileged actions after a session is already open.

title: How Privileged Can Your AI Become? More Than You Might Think
note: Frames privilege as dynamic and contextual for agents that can call tools, discover paths and expand effective reach during execution.

title: Countering misuse of AI: September 2026
note: Threat-intelligence reporting with identity-relevant examples including stolen credentials, admin-token amplification, CI/CD injection, session data and signing-key theft.

title: IAM remote MCP server generally available; Gemini role suggestions via Policy Assist API
note: Google's IAM release notes put agent-mediated IAM administration and AI-assisted role recommendations into production governance workflows.

title: FreeIPA 4.13.4 release notes: CVE-2026-13097 access-control flaw
note: Primary advisory material on an access-control flaw that could enable creation of reusable Kerberos identities and potentially reach administrative privilege.

title: Stolen MFA seeds mark a new stage in identity theft
note: Threat analysis on stolen TOTP seed material and session databases, useful for thinking about authentication infrastructure itself as privileged secret inventory.

title: Identity at machine speed: Securing the human, non-human, and agentic enterprise
note: A strategic read on governing human, machine and agent identities as one expanding identity-security problem rather than separate programs.

title: Introducing the Okta Managed MCP Server: Manage your Okta org with natural language
note: A concrete example of AI agents becoming IAM administrators through scoped OAuth and auditable MCP tooling, raising practical governance and approval questions.

title: Authorization in MCP 2026-07-28: Clarifying trust relationships for agentic systems
note: Architecture-focused treatment of trust relationships among users, hosts, agents, MCP servers, authorization servers and downstream resources.

title: MDRX cybersecurity incident disclosure
note: Material incident disclosure identifying compromised vendor credentials as the access path used to download patient data and describing the limits of that access.

title: Security update: September 2026 incident report
note: Affected-party disclosure tracing unauthorized access to an exposed internal test server and build-related credentials that required rotation and token revocation.

title: Notification of Data Security Incident
note: An identity-verification provider incident notice with durable implications for government-ID data, downstream fraud and identity-proofing risk.

title: MCP's new spec turns a planted prompt into a stolen credential
note: Analysis of MCP authorization and token-handling risks that is useful for teams designing delegated agent access, even though it is secondary reporting.

title: Revolut says customer KYC, Bitcoin transaction data exposed after fake request from gov't domain
note: A trust-and-authorization case study in which a request from a legitimate government-domain mailbox was reportedly used to obtain customer data.
